name: AutoLED
description: Place WS2812 / SMD LEDs as a 2D grid inside a shape from an SVG, PNG or BMP image, with schematic, PCB and LED map export.
description_full:
AutoLED fills a shape taken from an SVG, PNG, BMP or JPG image with a 2D grid of LEDs such as WS2812B, WS2812B-2020, SK6812MINI, 0805, 0603 or 1206.

The image is converted to black and white with a configurable threshold, scaled by width, height, percent or DPI, and LEDs are placed with a configurable pitch, border offset and grid shift, optionally keeping the whole LED body inside the shape. A live preview (zoom and pan) shows LEDs, decoupling capacitors, connectors and the data chain.

Outputs:
- the LED map as JSON, TXT and a C/C++ header (mask, chain index, row/column tables)
- a schematic: WS2812 daisy chain with decoupling caps and in/out connectors, or a row/column matrix for simple LEDs
- footprints placed on the PCB with nets, in a group that can be regenerated
- an optional board outline or cut line that follows the image shape (also exported as SVG and DXF)
- optional autorouting with Freerouting (requires Java and the Freerouting jar, e.g. from the Freerouting plugin)

Chain order: rows or columns, zigzag, start corner, optional 180 degree rotation of LEDs on backward lines. Capacitor rotation / position and connector footprint, pin order, placement and side are configurable.
